title: Design: one location ticked hides the Location column as pictured
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with every bucket collapsed.
  • The design picture "One location ticked" (ar-ap-p4-one-location-ticked.png) is attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the count reads "1 selected" and "Select all" is no longer ticked; as in the picture, while the menu stays open the rows do not move: {Location-A}, now unticked, stays where it was; the chip reads "Location: " and {Location-B}'s name, shortened with "..." when long ("Location: Staging Lethbri..." in the picture), still in a blue pill.
  • Step 3: the menu closes, and as in the picture the Location column is gone: the header row reads the chevron, then "Date", "Transaction Type", "ID", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Amount", "Open Balance".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S5-R6: “The chip reads "Location: All locations" when every location is ticked, the location's name when one is ticked (shortened with "..." when long), "Location: N locations" when N are ticked, and "Location: No locations" when none is.”
  • S6-R2: “The column is shown when two or more locations are ticked (All locations counts when the report's list has two or more) and hidden when one or none is ticked.”
  • S6-N1: “With one location chosen, the column is hidden on screen and in the export.”
  • S5-R2: “The Location chip and its open menu are the native ones, exactly as on Sales By Customer, Inventory Value and Work In Progress: label "Location" with the location pin icon; the menu shows a "Select all" row, a "{N} selected" count, the locations with the ticked ones first, a search box with the placeholder "Search locations" once there are more than 8 locations, and "Clear selection".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-one-location-ticked.png: figure "One location ticked" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"

The design's own words:

  • "One location ticked ("1 selected"): the chip names it, rows, totals and exports narrow to it, and the Location column hides. S5-R6, S5-R7, S5-R10, S6-N1." (caption of "One location ticked")

Design note (DR-02): the design shows with one location unticked and the menu still open, the ticked location is listed second ("Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" unticked above "Staging Lethbridge - 4310" ticked). Closed without a question: No conflict: PRD S5-R2 "the locations with the ticked ones first" is checked when the menu is opened again (S5-02, S5-03 close and reopen it); the picture shows the menu still open, where nothing moves. Native as on Sales By Customer.

Design note (DR-03): the design shows with one name ticked the chip keeps its prefix: "Location: Staging Lethbri...", "Customer: 10 Trucking", "Customer: Andrews' Truck ...". Closed without a question: No conflict: PRD S5-R6 / S5-R13 say the chip shows "the name" and the chips are "exactly as on Sales By Customer"; the design shows how (prefix kept, shortened with "..."). Cases now say what the picture shows.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified (no build yet)
